summary: SLM Student Loan Trust 2003-1 filed a Form 8-K reporting the furnishing of a preliminary remarketing memorandum for its Class A-5C Reset Rate Notes by Navient Solutions, LLC as administrator. The filing provides pool statistics as of April 30, 2026, but does not announce a special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change. The remarketing is an ordinary course debt financing activity for a structured finance vehicle. Accordingly, this filing does not trigger a special-situations category.
